# Frantz Augustin

> Personal website of Frantz Augustin, an independent researcher and software developer based in San Diego. He builds AI systems and writes about how machines and humans make meaning — from agent architectures to image captioning for accessibility. His work spans cognitive science, computational aesthetics, and human computer interaction.

Frantz has 6.5 years of software development experience (Python, TypeScript, Ruby on Rails) with academic foundations from Harvard Extension and MIT xPRO. He created a concept-driven architecture for AI agents and publishes ML experiments on HuggingFace.

## Research & Writing

- [Research & Writing](https://frantzaugustin.com/writing/): Research interests, technical writing, and curated micro-essays on cognition and intelligent systems
- [Move 37](https://frantzaugustin.com/writing/move-37/): A poem reflecting on AlphaGo's move 37, exploring unity, perfection, and the intersection of AI and meaning

## Projects & Experiments

- [Projects & Experiments](https://frantzaugustin.com/projects/): AI research projects, HuggingFace Spaces, and ML experiments
- [CaptionQuest](https://huggingface.co/spaces/Frantz103/CaptionQuest): Gradio app comparing AI captioning models side-by-side
- [Concept-Driven Architecture](https://frantzaugustin.com/projects/): A framework for more effective AI agents grounded in conceptual reasoning
- [Image Captioning for Accessibility](https://github.com/Frantz103/image-caption-accessibility): Evaluating AI captions against POUR accessibility principles
- [HuggingFace Profile](https://huggingface.co/Frantz103): Full collection of models, Spaces, and datasets

## Pages

- [About](https://frantzaugustin.com/about/): Bio, background, ML journey, research focus, and collaboration interests. Focus areas: cognitive science, HCI, machine perception, computational aesthetics, agent architecture, philosophy of mind, local AI systems
- [Creative Work](https://frantzaugustin.com/creative/): Two creative practices — Frantz Photography and Frantz Studio
- [Field Notes](https://frantzaugustin.com/field-notes/): Living snapshot of current projects and research directions
- [Contact](https://frantzaugustin.com/contact/): Contact form and social links (LinkedIn, GitHub, HuggingFace, Medium, Photography, Threads, Substack)
- [Learning Timeline](https://frantzaugustin.com/timeline/): Chronological technical milestones — from early ML experiments through agent architectures and computational aesthetics
